_comment: Copy this to ~/.neomind/fin/seed_philosophy.json and fill in your PERSONAL Investment Policy Statement. That path is gitignored — your real holdings / position sizes / drawdown tolerance never enter git. Alternatively, just edit via the IPS editor UI (writes to the DB, also gitignored).
north_star: 用一句话: 为什么投资 + 目标 CAGR + 能承受的最大 drawdown
identity: 一段话: 你是什么类型的投资者, 持有期偏好, 决策风格, edge 来源
beliefs_json: [{"claim": "可证伪的核心信念", "why": "为什么相信", "falsified_if": "什么证据会推翻它"}]
circle_competence: 会做什么 / 不会做什么
time_horizon: 默认持有期 + core vs 试探仓的不同规则
entry_rules: 建仓前必须满足的条件清单
hedge_plan: 主线 thesis 失败的对冲方案
disagreement_protocol: 跟 smart money 反向时的处理流程
